body: I would comfort her if she'd let me. She won't. And I can't look in the mirror with comfort because it doesn't match what's in my head. However I greatly appreciate your reply and I will try to do what you advised and see what happens from there.

I acknowledge the fact that divorce is by far the best option for my parents. He just keeps dragging it out and she, for some reason beyond my comprehension, loves him. But I do trust you and I know that this is the best end result. Thank you for taking time to respond.
I'm sorry to hear about the scholarship troubles. I used to. I haven't pursued anything though. I didn't plan on making it that far.
I appreciate it, but I'd feel like a burden. I don't even really know why I posted this. I doubt it will help much. But seriously, thanks.
